name: nexasalud
description: Plataforma segura de gestión de citas médicas

scripts.dev: pnpm run infra:up && pnpm run dev:web
scripts.dev:api: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/compose.yaml up -d --build --wait api gateway
scripts.test:api: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/compose.yaml exec -T api php artisan test
scripts.lint:api: docker compose --env-file infra/.env -f infra/compose.yaml exec -T api vendor/bin/pint --test
